operations.details: Verified official OGC API - Features standard page.
Feature geometry access separated from exact HMLR legal-boundary evidence.
WGS84/default or alternate CRS support not treated as a parcel survey accuracy guarantee.
Generic feature identity not substituted for exact HMLR title/polygon identity.
Verified official OGC API - Maps standard page.
Styled map rendering separated from raw numeric coverage/elevation values.
Requested output size or CRS not promoted to source resolution or accuracy improvement.
Map image rejected as direct terrain-height observation.
Features and Maps standard URLs distinct from prior source registry.
No feature/map portrayal substituted for numeric parcel result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
